job.name: Sync Environment Secrets Across Microservices
job.description: Backend developers configuring microservice deployment pipelines across staging and production.

steps.name: 5. Execute manual copy-paste into CI/CD secrets
6. Monitor pipeline build for config missing errors
7. Modify mismatched keys upon failed deploy

outcomes.statement: Minimize the time taken to propagate secrets across environments
Minimize the likelihood of exposing plain-text keys in build logs
Minimize the effort required to rotate expired tokens in running pods

evidence.name: Fintech Customer Call #104
evidence.content: We had a junior engineer push code that broke staging because the Stripe secret wasn't copied over. Three senior engineers spent two hours on it. There has to be a better way than copy-pasting strings.

evidence.name: Slack #incident-deployments
evidence.content: Third time this week staging broke after a secret rotation. We need automated synchronization across microservices.

evidence.name: Vault Migration RFC
evidence.content: Developer survey shows 85% of time spent on deployment blockers is caused by missing env variables in microservice pipelines.
